headline: Referred Zoning Board of Appeals, Planning Board and Village Review Overlay Zone ordinance amendments to City Council; tabled Public Safety Commission changes.
summary: Councilors also referred amendments for four other boards and committees to City Council. Discussion of the Public Safety Commission amendments was tabled so staff can review them further.
decisions: Referred ordinance amendments from July 20, 2026 for four boards and committees to City Council, 6-0-1.
Tabled Public Safety Commission ordinance amendments to a future meeting, 6-0-1.
Referred Zoning Board of Appeals ordinance amendments to City Council, 6-0.
Referred Planning Board ordinance amendments to City Council, 6-0-1.
Referred Village Review Overlay Zone ordinance amendments to City Council, 6-0-1.

plain_text:
WESTBROOK CITY COUNCIL 
COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE MEETING MINUTES 
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 14, 2026 AT 7:00 PM  
WESTBROOK HIGH SCHOOL (ROOM 114) 
125 STROUDWATER ST.  
 
 
  
 
I. ROLL CALL 
Meeting called to order at 6:00pm by Committee of the Whole Chair Gary Rairdon  
 
City Councilors Present: Michael Shaughnessy (At-Large, Vice-President), Anna A. Turcotte (Ward 3), Victor 
Chau (Ward 2), Amy Faulkingham (Ward 4), Jennifer Munro (Ward 5, President), Gary Rairdon (At-Large) 
 
City Councilors Absent: Brian McCambridge (Ward 1) 
 
Other City Officials Present: Jennie Franceschi (Assistant City Administrator), Angela Holmes (City 
Administrator), Ellis Ledoux (City Clerk), David Morse (Mayor),  
 
  
II. ORDINANCE UPDATES FOR CITY BOARDS, COMMISSIONS & COMMITTEES  
 Previously Reviewed Items. Referral of ordinance amendments reviewed at the July 20, 2026 
Committee of the Whole meeting to City Council for consideration:  
• Board of Assessment Review 
• Board of Trustees of the Woodlawn Cemetery 
• Fair Hearing Authority 
• Library Advisory Committee 
 Motion to review ordinance amendments from July 20, 2026  
Moved by President Munro, seconded by Councilor Faulkingham 
Committee Chair Rairdon opened the floor for committee discussion. The following spoke: No one 
spoke.  
Committee Chair Rairdon opened the floor for public comment. The following spoke: No one spoke 
Motion carried. Vote (6-0-1) 
Ayes: Shaughnessy, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Rairdon, Munro 
Nays: None 
Absent: McCambridge 
 
  
 New Items for Review. Review of proposed ordinance amendments relating to the following 
municipal boards, commissions, and committees, and referral to City Council for consideration:  
• Zoning Board of Appeals 
• Public Safety Commission  
• Planning Board  
• Village Review Overlay Zone Committee
Committee Chair Rairdon gave the floor to Angela Holmes (City Administrator) to  introduce the new 
items for review.  
City Administrator Holmes asked the Committee for a motion requesting to table the Public Safety 
Commission for further staff review. Chair Rairdon opened the floor to public comment on this item. 
The following spoke: Mike Fandell (Chair), Dustin Sleight, via email 
Move to table Public Safety Committee discussion to a future Committee of the Whole meeting. 
Moved by Council Chau, seconded by President Munro 
Motion carried.  (Vote 6-0-1) 
Ayes: Shaughnessy, McCambridge, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Munro 
Nays: None 
Absent: McCambridge 
 
Zoning Board of Appeals 
Angela Holmes (City Administrator) provided an overview of the review process for this board, and 
gave the floor to Jennie Franceschi (Assistant City Administrator) to outline City recommendations. The 
following councilors asked questions: Councilor Turcotte, Jennie Franceschi (Assistant City 
Administrator), Cameron Ferrante (Legal Counsel), Mayor Morse, Chair Rairdon 
 
Motion to refer Zoning Board of Appeals ordinance amendments to City Council 
Moved by President Munro, seconded by Councilor Chau 
Committee Chair Rairdon opened the floor to committee discussion. The following spoke: No one 
spoke.  
Motion carried. Vote (6-0) 
Ayes: Shaughnessy, McCambridge, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Munro 
Nays: None 
Absent: McCambridge 
 
Planning Board 
Angela Holmes (City Administrator) provided an overview of the review process for this board, and 
gives the floor to Jennie Franceschi (Assistant City Administrator) to outline City recommendations. The 
following councilors asked questions: Councilor Chau, Camron Ferrante (Legal Counsel), Angela Holmes 
(City Administrator), Councilor Turcotte 
 
Motion to refer Planning Board Ordinance amendments to City Council 
Moved by President Munro, seconded by Councilor Chau 
Committee Chair Rairdon opened the floor to committee discussion. The following spoke: No one 
spoke.  
Motion carried. Vote (6-0-1) 
Ayes: Shaughnessy, McCambridge, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Munro 
Nays: None 
Absent: McCambridge 
 
Village Review Overlay Zone  
Angela Holmes (City Administrator) provided an overview of the review process for this board and gave 
the floor to Jennie Franceschi (Assistant City Administrator) to outline City recommendations. The 
following councilors asked questions: Councilor Chau, Angela Holmes (City Administrator), Vice 
President Shaughnessy
Motion to refer Village Review Overlay Zone Ordinance Amendments to City Council 
Moved by Munro, seconded by Councilor Chau 
Committee Chair Rairdon opened the floor to committee discussion. The following spoke: No one 
spoke.  
Motion carried. Vote (6-0-1) 
Ayes: Shaughnessy, McCambridge, Chau, Turcotte, Faulkingham, Munro 
Nays: None 
Absent: McCambridge 
 
  
III. ADJOURNMENT 
Motion to adjourn at 8:36pm 
Moved by Councilor Turcotte, seconded by President Munro 
Motion carried by a show of hands. None opposed.
